paite: Huchi in nang ka tapa, Khrist Jesu a hehpihna om ah thilhihtheihna nei in om in.
heading: Khrist Jesu Sepaih Hoih
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Theihpih tampite lak a ka kam a thu na zakte, mimuanhuai, midangte hilhsawn thei dingte kiang ah kemsak in.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

paite: Khrist Jesu sepaih hoih bang in gimthuak hon thuakpih in.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

paite: Sepaih a om ding a atelpa kipahsak ahihtheihna ding in, sepaih kuamah kidou lai in hiai damsung khosaknate in akisubuai ngei kei hi.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

paite: Huan kidemnate ah mite pang mahleh dan bang a ahihkeileh khuksak in a-om ngei kei hi.
heading: Kimawlmi Leh Louneimi A Pan Sinlai
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

paite: Louneipa semgim agah tang masapa ahih ding ahi.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

paite: Ka thugentak ngaihtuah in; Toupa'n thil tengteng ah theihsiamna ahon pe ding hi.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

paite: Jesu Khrist, David suan ka tanchinhoih gen bang a misi lak a kipan a thounawnpa theigige in.
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

paite: Huai tanchinhoih ziak in thil hihkhialpa bang in hen hial in gimna ka thuak zel hi; himahleh Pathian thu hen in a-om kei hi.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist Jesu a hotdamna tangtawn a thupina toh amuh sam theihna ding un, telte ziak in bangkim ka thuak hi.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

paite: Hiai thugen adik hi: "Asihna a i sih khit ngalleh, ahinna ah i hing ding hi.
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

paite: I thuak leh avaihawmna ah vai i hawm sam ding hi; amah i kitheihmohbawlleh ama'n leng hon kitheihmohbawl ding.
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

paite: Eite muanhuai lou in om mah lehang, Amah zaw muanhuai in a-om gige hi; amah-le-amah akitheihmohbawl thei ngal kei a.”
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

paite: Hiai theisak inla, thute leltak tung a akisellouhna ding un Toupa muh in phatuamngaitak in theisak in; huai kiselna bangmah aphatuam kei a, angaikhete a ding in siatna ahi zaw hi.
heading: Pathian Pomtak Nasemmi
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

paite: Nasemtu, zumna ding nei lou, thutak thu diktak a zang, Pathian pomtak hi ding a nangmah kipe ding in theihtawp suah in kisin in.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

paite: Himahleh Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawkte nungngatsan in; huchibang mite Pathian limsaklouhna lam ah apai gamla semsem ding ua,
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

paite: athu un meima sia nek bang in ane zel ding; alak uah Himenaias leh Philetas apang uhi.
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

paite: Huai mite'n thohnawnna a-om khinta chi in thutak lam apialsan ua, mi khenkhatte ginna ahihmangsak uhi.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

paite: Himahleh Pathian suangphum kip adingh lai a, hiai chiamtehna anei hi: "Toupa'n ama ate athei," chih leh, "Toupa min lou peuhmah in diktatlouhna paisan hen," chih.
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

paite: Himahleh inn thupi ah tui-um belsuan dangka-eng leh dangka a bawlte kia a-om kei a, sing leh bellei a bawlte leng a-om hi; khenkhatte manphatak a zat a-om a, khenkhatte manpha lou deuh a zat leng a-om sam hi.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

paite: Huaiziak in mi huai thil manphaloute lak a akihepleh tui-um belsuan manphatak a zat ding, siangthou, apu a dia zat tak, nasep hoih chiteng a dia mansa ahi ding hi.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

paite: Himahleh valnou duhgawlnate taisan inla, lungtang siangthou a Toupa sam peuhmahte lak adiktatna, ginna, itna leh khamuanna delh in.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

paite: Himahleh kidounate asuaksak nak chih thei in, kiselna haihuai leh pil lou ah pang nuam ke'n.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

paite: Toupa sikha in adou ding ahi kei a, mi tengteng tung ah siam tum in, thuhilh siam in, gitlouh tung a thuakzou in,
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

paite: amah doute thunuailuttak in athuhilh zaw ding hỉ. Huchi in Pathian in thutak atheihna ding un akisiksak zenzen kha ding hi,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

paite: huchi in khua ahon theithei ding ua, amaute suak-le-sal a man a a-utut a bawlpa diabol thang a kipan asuakta thei ding uh.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
